page.layout: One page of running text in a single column; running head at the top, page number at the top left; no margin notes; closing ornament below "Vale." (not text).

main_text.p: rum enumeratione : poftremo conclu-fione, quæ Ciceronis ἐπιχειρήσιν[?] iudicium & fententiam complectitur. Quas nos huncin modum exprimere partes pote-rimus.
I. Illuferas proximo in colloquio, quod dixeram, inter ipsos Philosophos controuerfiam esse, posset nec ne hac in vita certo aliquid sciri, aut cognosci.

II. Itaque etsi domum reuersus alia negotia inueneram: tamen locos quosdam notaui, & descri-ptos tibi misi: ut scires Herillos, Pyrrhonios, & Academicos maxime recentiores scientiam omnem è medio fustulisse[?].

III. Ego tamen Platoni & Aristoteli assentior, qui ut sciri posse omnia, minimè afferunt: ita sciri quoque nihil verè negant: cum, ut alia nunc mittam, discendi ardorem restinguí: artes & discipli-nas cunctas corrumpere: legum atque honestatis omnis ruinam sequi necesse sit, si sciri à nobis nihil hac posse in vita sta-tuatur. Vale.

page.notes: Greek word after "Ciceronis" is read as ἐπιχειρήσιν with doubt; the final letters are uncertain. "fustulisse" is uncertain (ligatures are heavy). Blotches and stains on the page are not printed text. The closing ornament after "Vale." is a printer's mark and not transcribed.
